messages:
Leah (People Ops): Drafting a compact manager onboarding packet: first-week agenda, a short 30/60/90 template, and a who-to-ask cheat sheet. Please add gaps.

Leah (People Ops): DRAFT (super compact):
• Pre-start: laptop + SSO + VPN tested (IT owner)
• Day 1 AM: team kickoff + schedule 1:1s
• Day 1 PM: runtime intro (45m) — inference flow + KV cache basics (eng-runtime)
• Week 1: shadow standups, review outstanding tickets, meet product & infra
• Week 2: finalize 30/60/90, complete Security 101 + Data Handling
• 30/60/90 template: 3 measurable outcomes each (examples below)
• Who-to-ask: IT (access), Eng-Infra (deploys), Eng-Security (keys), Finance, People-Ops, Legal

Samir (Eng Manager): Add a 60m deep-dive on batching/quantization effects and links to #eng-oncall + PagerDuty runbook. Also paste this infra ticket stub when blocked: 
```
Subject: New manager infra access - <name>
Tried: VPN, laptop restart, kube-auth refresh
Attach: screenshot, logs
Priority: P2
```

Priya (Recruiting): Please include manager expectations: weekly 1:1s, skip-level within 30 days, and a reminder to submit hiring feedback templates.

Ava (HR): New managers must sign the data access addendum for private deployment keys. I'll attach compliance links and due dates.

Maddie (Onboarding Buddy): I can be buddy for first 2 weeks and run shadow sessions. Prefer AM deep-dive blocks.

Leah (People Ops): Thanks — I'll fold in the runtime deep-dive, pager links, infra stub, and Priya/Ava notes. Will send a final for review by EOD Friday.
